text_block_list.text:
During training, Mejiro McQueen complained 
of feeling unwell, so I brought her to the 
nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems a bit of fatigue had built up. I 
apologize for causing you concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I feel much better now. 
Well then, let us resume our training.
choice_data_list: No training until you're fully recovered.

No good, let's rethink the plan from 
scratch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I feel much better now. 
Well then, let us resume our training.
choice_data_list: No training until you're fully recovered.
No, let's rethink the menu from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
B-Banned!? But I know perfectly well how 
to manage myself when in poor condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure if she just rests a little, 
she'll be fine this time too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... aren't you being unusually pushy 
today!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. It is unfortunate, but as 
you say, I shall rest for a while."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Such a stubborn person.

That day, I had Mejiro McQueen focus 
entirely on resting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No way...! After Trainer went out of their 
way to design it just for me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can judge for myself whether I've 
reached my limit. Therefore, this much is 
no problem at all...!
choice_data_list:
It'll be too late once you've already 
collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Guh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly sorry for causing trouble due 
to my lack of self-discipline..."

Perhaps her mental state was a factor as 
well, but Mejiro McQueen's injury was 
taking quite a long time to heal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This outcome was born entirely of my own 
shortcomings. I shall accept it gracefully 
this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, for the next menu, I request 
something even more demanding than this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'll get it fixed right away, and next 
time, I'll definitely meet your 
expectations, Trainer!

True to her declaration, she healed her 
injury right away and showed fantastic 
form the very next day.
